items.title: The Magnificent 7 are back: Meta’s AI bet leads the charge
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor and host of Sozzi Unleashed, Brian Sozzi, tees up the stories making waves across the markets. The Magnificent 7 are back in focus as megacap tech stocks help push markets higher, with Meta (META) leading the charge after its new Muse AI agent gained momentum and climbed to the top spot on Apple's (AAPL) App Store.

items.title: Meta stock jumps as Wells Fargo raises price target
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination to discuss Meta (META) more than 10% intraday surge after Wells Fargo (WFC) raised its price target on the stock from $640 to $796. Meta also got a boost from its Meta Muse AI agent app climbing to the top spot on Apple's (AAPL) App Store, highlighting growing momentum around the company's AI push.

items.title: Price Prediction: Marvell, AMD & Broadcom- Our Bold Price Predictions for 2027
items.summary: Marvell, AMD, and Broadcom are all sitting above Wall Street's consensus targets right now, yet one bold analyst sees each of them with meaningful room left to run before 2027 ends.

items.title: AI Is Hollowing Out Software Jobs — But Paying Survivors a Fortune
items.summary: The software job market is splitting in two, and the dividing line is not skill or effort. A new report reveals who wins, who disappears, and why the cycle may be impossible to break.

items.title: Microsoft Drops as Three-Zone Hyderabad Region Goes Live
items.summary: A fourth Indian cloud region adds sovereign-ready capacity without disclosing site-level megawatts or revenue.

items.title: “Market Has to Chew Through Indigestion”: Analyst Warns of 7000 Dip Before 8150 Target
items.summary: RBC's top equity strategist just named a price level that should make every S&P 500 investor uncomfortable, and she said it while defending a target most bulls would celebrate. The two positions are not contradictory, but reconciling them changes everything about how you hold this market.

items.title: Is CrowdStrike Stock A Buy Today As AI Threats Lift Demand?
items.summary: The popular view of CrowdStrike (CRWD) is that AI has made a fast-growing security company grow even faster. The stock returned 98% over the past year. The S&P 500 returned 18.5% over the same period. For that view to be right, two things must both be true. The faster growth has to last, and it has to turn into real profit. So far, only the first one clearly holds.
